tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: Returns every slide section (problem, team, traction, ask and the rest) with its id, name, a one-line meaning, how many slide images it has and the share of decks that include it. Call it first to get the section ids that search_slides takes. For numbers to compare a deck against, such as median sli

tools.name: search_slides
tools.description: Returns example slides from real pre-seed, angel and seed pitch decks, filtered by section, stage, outcome, reviewer verdict or words. Use it to show what a section looks like in practice; get section ids from list_sections. Only slides with an image are searched. Results are spread across decks: ea

tools.name: list_decks
tools.description: Returns a summary of every deck in the library, optionally filtered by stage and outcome. Use it to find deck ids; call get_deck for one deck with all its slides, or search_slides to find slides across decks. Each item has id, company, stage, amount, year, outcome, outcome_note, slide_count, url, so

tools.name: get_deck
tools.description: Returns one deck: its summary, company facts and every listed slide in order with its section. Use it when you need a whole deck; for a single slide call get_slide, and for decks you have no id for call list_decks first. Each slide has n (1-based), section, section_name, label, appendix, image_url,

tools.name: get_slide
tools.description: Returns one slide of one deck, with the deck summary, by deck id and slide number. Use it to look up a slide you already know, such as one named in a get_deck or search_slides result; use get_deck for the whole deck. The result has deck (the summary) and the slide fields from get_deck, plus position

tools.name: section_benchmarks
tools.description: Returns numbers for comparing a deck's structure: the median slide count and, for each section, the share of decks that have it and the median slide where it first appears. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_decks · Public sink: list_sections, section_benchmarks.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_decks · Public sink: list_sections, section_benchmarks

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
